how.heading: From item to payment in four steps
how.step1Text: Walk in or book a time. Bring damaged or unmarked jewellery too — we determine the fineness ourselves.
how.step2Text: Items are weighed on a calibrated scale and tested for fineness. You see every step, and we explain it as we go.
how.step3Text: We name an exact figure. Take your time to decide — the offer commits you to nothing.
how.step4Text: Accept the offer and you are paid on the spot.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Items are weighed on a calibrated scale and tested for fineness. Everything happens in front of you, and we explain the process as we go. Appraisal is free and takes a few minutes.
faq.q2: How much is my gold worth?
faq.a2: Weight, fineness and the day's market rate set the value. Bring your items in for a free appraisal or call us for an exact assessment.
faq.a3: Yes. The law requires seller identification when precious metals are bought. Your details are kept as regulations require and are not passed to third parties.
faq.q4: Do you buy damaged or old jewellery?
faq.a4: Yes. Scratches, broken chains or a missing pair don't reduce the metal's value — that is set by weight and fineness.
faq.a5: Immediately, as soon as you accept the offer.
faq.q6: Do you buy silver as well?
faq.a6: Yes — silver jewellery, coins, bars and tableware in 925 and 999 fineness.

privacy.title: Privacy policy — Silberberg
privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data this site collects and how it is handled.
privacy.controllerText: Controller details (full company name, address, contact) will be published before launch.
privacy.collectText: This website does not collect contact submissions or contact details through a form. If you call the business, any information you share is handled by phone. The site sets no tracking cookies; choosing a language manually stores a single functional cookie with that preference.
privacy.purposeText: Any information you choose to share by phone is used solely to assist with your appraisal. It is not shared with third parties or used for advertising.
privacy.retentionText: The site does not store contact submissions. Any business records made after a phone call are kept no longer than needed and then deleted; exact periods will be set before launch.
privacy.rightsText: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data at any time, and may lodge a complaint with the Slovenian Information Commissioner.
